location_description:
North York is a borough, adjacent to the city of York, in York County, Pennsylvania. As of the 2020 census, the borough had a total population of 2,196.


== Geography ==
North York is located at 39°58'40" North, 76°43'53" West (39.977814, -76.731481).According to the United States Census Bureau, the borough has a total area of 0.3 square miles (0.78 km2), of which, 0.3 square miles (0.78 km2) of it is land and none of the area is covered with water.
